note: Replaced the overlapping primitive ears with continuous front and rear pinna surfaces and finer cartilage folds. The geometry holds up in front, side and back views, but ear shading and attachment still need refinement. Overall likeness score is unchanged.

revisions.title: First complete assembly
revisions.notes: Recognizable outfit and pose. Facial banding, scalp gaps, tooth shape and sock intersections need correction.

revisions.title: Continuous surfaces and complete scalp
revisions.notes: Scalp gaps and sock intersections corrected. Facial proportions, smile, strap width and cloth detail remain below the reference target.

revisions.title: Proportion and smile correction
revisions.notes: More faithful skirt length, strap width and restrained smile. Complete rear geometry. Facial likeness and natural hair flow still need refinement.

revisions.title: Eyes and hair refinement
revisions.notes: Clipped irises, visible lip surfaces, conforming hair strands. Stylized facial likeness still needs work.

revisions.title: Lighter geometry and fabric
revisions.notes: Reduced mesh density, corrected tie stripe direction, and fixed mobile panel sizing. Close inspection identified wrist and shoe seams.

revisions.title: Connected hands and fitted footwear
revisions.notes: Continuous palm and finger surfaces replace assembled pieces. Loafer seams conform to the shoe surface. Wrist joins still needed work.

revisions.title: Unified hands and forearms
revisions.notes: Hands and forearms share one surface. Visual inspection caught a clipping defect in the meshing boundary.

revisions.title: Closed surfaces and tucked fabric
revisions.notes: Expanded meshing bounds remove the forearm opening. Shirt hem tuck improved. Hands, back, side and outfit inspected.

revisions.title: Softer smiling expression
revisions.notes: Refined eyelid opening, nose details, head tilt, and ponytail taper. Facial likeness remains stylized, below the requested 95/100 target.

revisions.title: Standalone model and fast web loading
revisions.notes: Both GLBs pass formal validation with zero errors or warnings. The compressed model preserves appearance and loads without procedural reconstruction. Visual likeness remains 73/100.

revisions.title: Touch controls and release checks
revisions.notes: Reset clears orbit momentum and turntable state. Camera/material controls, touch orbit, GLB download integrity and PNG snapshots pass. Visual likeness remains 73/100.

revisions.title: Anatomical topology trial: winding regression
revisions.notes: Continuous face and real openings work, but reversed ring winding hid eyelids, irises and lips. This trial is a regression, not an accepted likeness improvement.

revisions.title: Surface winding corrected; facial transition review
revisions.notes: Irises and lip rings are visible again. Review found a bright eyelid seam and oral cavity overlap; these remain below the previous accepted likeness.

revisions.title: Continuous facial surfaces and layered hair trial
revisions.notes: Eye and mouth openings now render correctly, with recessed teeth and integrated tissue. Hair is more detailed but the fringe has conspicuous pointed segments; photographic likeness remains limited.

revisions.title: Coherent swept fringe and elevated camera
revisions.notes: The rigid segmented bangs are replaced by a continuous combed surface. Camera elevation better exposes the shoes. The face still has overly protruding eyes and a long lower jaw.

revisions.title: Embedded eyes and corrected head placement
revisions.notes: The head tilt and lateral placement are closer, and the eyes are less protruding. Enlarged reference review shows the jaw is still too broad, the irises too small, and ponytail tips incorrectly sit behind the blouse.

revisions.title: Narrower jaw and forward-draped ponytails
revisions.notes: The lower jaw tapers more naturally, irises fill the eyes and ponytails now lie over the shirt rather than disappearing behind it. Remaining weaknesses include synthetic hair highlights and the stiff collar and garment silhouette.

revisions.title: Recovered garment trial
revisions.notes: Recovered interrupted revision. The collar has visible gaps and stiff edges; hair remains synthetic. Target not met.

revisions.title: Facial contour trial — smile regression
revisions.notes: Nose and philtrum are softer, but the changed mouth corners read as a grimace. The eyelids still have conspicuous socket transitions. This is a scored trial, not an accepted improvement.

revisions.title: Integrated eye surfaces and revised smile
revisions.notes: Eye surfaces blend more gently into the cheeks and nose. The mouth still looks synthetic, and the reference has more compact lower-face proportions. Collar and hair remain the next major corrections.

revisions.title: Open collar and chest continuity trial
revisions.notes: The neckline no longer exposes a background gap, but close inspection found a folded-over upper shirt surface, inward-facing tie loops and a ragged tuck transition. These are being corrected rather than scored as finished.

revisions.title: Connected neckline, visible tie loops and clean tuck
revisions.notes: Corrected inward-facing necktie loops, non-monotonic neckline mapping and skirt-waist intersections. Rounded sleeve caps now join the torso. Face and hair likeness remain below target.

revisions.title: Shorter hair and reduced synthetic glare
revisions.notes: Ponytail lengths are closer and distracting silver highlights are reduced. The groom is still too solid and the face remains stylized; score is unchanged.

revisions.title: Skin microstructure and oral-depth review
revisions.notes: Added original procedural pore normals and smoother tissue transitions. Close three-quarter inspection shows the mouth is too wide and the teeth intersect the inner lip contour; these remain active defects.

revisions.title: More restrained feature scale and recessed teeth
revisions.notes: Eye openings and smile width are closer to the reference; teeth are set behind the lip boundary. The complexion, brows and hair still look synthetic. This is not a 95-level likeness.

revisions.title: Directional daylight trial
revisions.notes: Stronger directional lighting reveals depth but creates harsh facial shadows and emphasizes simplified planes. This is a lighting trial, not a likeness improvement.

revisions.title: Balanced daylight trial
revisions.notes: Balanced directional and environment light is clearer than the harsh trial without washing out the character. Geometric likeness remains unchanged.

revisions.title: Soft portrait light trial
revisions.notes: The softer light reduces harsh shadows but washes out facial structure. Balanced trial 27 is selected for subsequent work.

revisions.title: Natural eyebrow fibres and balanced daylight
revisions.notes: Original eyebrow fibre density now complements the fine hair geometry. Balanced daylight is retained. The face is still visibly stylized; the thin upper-lip highlight and thick hair clumps remain active issues.

revisions.title: Continuous tissue normals and upper eyelid folds
revisions.notes: Matched surface normals across skin boundaries and removed the harsh upper-lip highlight. Eyelid folds are visible. Material isolation confirms the lip geometry is intact; facial likeness remains below target.

revisions.title: True nostril openings — rim-shading regression
revisions.notes: Nostrils now have real recessed geometry, but the first trial produces overexposed rims and visible triangular shading around the openings. This is a regression, not a completed improvement.

revisions.title: Recovered nasal-surface correction
revisions.notes: Recessed nasal openings are preserved, but bright rims, synthetic eye contours and heavy hair clumps remain. Recovered front, portrait and profile views were reviewed; the requested target is not reached.

revisions.title: Softer eye aperture and restrained smile
revisions.notes: Reduced eye protrusion and lower tooth exposure. Nasal highlights and synthetic expression remained unresolved. Original captures were lost in the Colab restore; this is the recovered source change, not an extra iteration.

revisions.title: Continuous facial texture coordinates
revisions.notes: Unified skin coordinates across eye and nose patches. The nasal highlights remained; diagnostic trials did not count as a visual improvement. Original captures were lost in the Colab restore; this is the recovered source change, not an extra iteration.

revisions.title: Broader reference-led smile and cheek volume
revisions.notes: The broader smile and fuller cheeks were recovered and the front and portrait captures regenerated after Colab restored an older snapshot.

revisions.title: Fine ribbon groom and focused shadows - rejected trial
revisions.notes: The original trial produced glittering hair and harsh shadows. Original captures were lost in the Colab restore; this review is retained without inventing replacement evidence.

revisions.title: Recovered matte fibres and irregular ponytail waves
revisions.notes: The corrected fibre material and less uniform ponytail waves are restored. Front, portrait, three-quarter, side and back captures have been regenerated after the Colab restore. This is recovery of an existing review, not a new iteration. Facial likeness remains below target.

revisions.title: Direct nasal aperture trial - shading regression
revisions.notes: This previously reviewed trial exposed long facial shading streaks. Its captures were lost during Colab restore. Revision 39 is replacing the surface sampling and normal evaluation rather than accepting the defect.

revisions.title: Continuous facial surface without nasal streaks
revisions.notes: Rebuilt the facial sampling around the eyes, mouth and direct nasal openings, with explicit analytical surface normals. The long nasal shading streaks are removed in front and three-quarter views. The remaining likeness gap is concentrated in the eye construction, smile and skin detail.

revisions.title: Inset-eye assembly trial - lower-lid intersection
revisions.notes: Complete curved eyeballs and unclamped irises replace the former flat apertures. The first placement is too far forward and protrudes through the lower eyelids, so this trial is a regression rather than a finished improvement.

revisions.title: Seated eyes with continuous eyelid coverage
revisions.notes: The eyeballs now sit behind the facial skin and no longer protrude through the lower lids. Curved irises and restrained reflections read more naturally in portrait and three-quarter views. Facial proportions, ears and the smile still differ from the reference.

revisions.title: Coordinated facial-proportion controls
revisions.notes: The new proportion controls are reproducible, but visual comparison shows excessive feature lift, a compressed lower face and overly tall teeth. This trial is not scored as a likeness improvement; those proportions are being corrected.

revisions.title: Rounded tooth crowns and restored lower-face length
revisions.notes: The teeth are no longer rectangular bars and the nose-to-eye distance is closer to the reference. The profile exposes an abrupt chin transition, and the visible tooth height still needs balancing. The score is unchanged.

revisions.title: Smoother jaw contour and reference-led head inclination
revisions.notes: The tapered lower face and forward chin now transition more smoothly in portrait and profile. Head inclination is closer to the reference, and tooth coverage is improved. Ear anatomy, skin shading and hair flow remain substantial likeness gaps.

revisions.title: Continuous concave ear anatomy
revisions.notes: Replaced the overlapping primitive ears with continuous front and rear pinna surfaces and finer cartilage folds. The geometry holds up in front, side and back views, but ear shading and attachment still need refinement. Overall likeness score is unchanged.
